slides.headline: A VIRAL POST CLAIMED TRUMP SHARED THIS IMAGE
slides.body: A post on X showed what it said was an AI image Trump posted to Truth Social. The image was supposed to show Trump standing with JFK, Gandhi, and Jesus. But the AI put Jared Leto's face where Jesus should be

slides.headline: TRUMP NEVER POSTED IT
slides.body: A community note confirmed the entire image was fake. Trump never shared it on any platform. The real AI image he posted on Truth Social only showed himself and JFK

slides.headline: THE TWEET HIT 1.3 MILLION VIEWS
slides.body: The post calling out the fake got 53,000 likes and 22,500 retweets in under two days. Best reply: "Jesus Leto isn't real, he can't hurt you"
